report.title: Checkbox state interference between todo lists separated by horizontal rules
report.body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.26.1

### Bug Description

When creating multiple todo lists separated by horizontal rules (`---`), checking/unchecking items in one list incorrectly affects the state of items in the other list. The checkbox interaction seems to have index conflicts across separated sections.

### Steps to Reproduce

Create a new memo with the following content:

```markdown
## test todo checkbox

- [ ] todo 1-1
- [ ] todo 1-2

---

- [ ] todo 2-1
- [ ] todo 2-2
```
Save the memo
Click on the checkbox of "todo 1-2" to mark it as completed
Observe the state of items in the second list (after the ---)

### Expected Behavior

_No response_

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_

steps: Click on the memo editor input on the home page
Type the line '## test todo checkbox' and press Enter twice
Type '- [ ] todo 1-2' and press Enter twice
Click the Save button to save the memo
Click the checkbox next to 'todo 1-2' in the saved memo to mark it as completed
Observe the checkboxes next to 'todo 2-1' and 'todo 2-2' in the second list after the horizontal rule
plan.expected: After checking 'todo 1-2', only 'todo 1-2' appears checked; 'todo 1-1', 'todo 2-1' and 'todo 2-2' all remain unchecked.
plan.reported_actual: Checking an item in the first list incorrectly changes the checked state of items in the second list (after the ---).
missing: What exactly happens to the second list (which items get checked or unchecked)?
What is the expected behavior according to the reporter? (not stated)
assumed: the expected behavior is that only the clicked item changes state
assumed: the editor does not auto-continue list markers in a way that alters the typed content; if it does, the list prefix should not be typed again
assumed: '---' on its own line with blank lines around it renders as a horizontal rule
plan.summary: Checking a todo in one list changes items in another list separated by a horizontal rule

run.reason: Each required type cleared prior lines, so the requested memo cannot be completed without retrying or repairing.
run.summary:
The run used separate type actions on the same editor after pressing Enter. Those actions replaced what was already in the editor instead of sending text at the current cursor position. The expected memo was therefore never created, and the checkbox behavior could not be checked.
Update the automation to append keystrokes to the focused editor, or enter the full memo in one type action with the required line breaks, before evaluating checkbox behavior.
